d: Saudi German Health is hiring - Senior Network Security Engineer - Jeddah
We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to join our team and support the security of our enterprise network, endpoints, remote access, and applications.
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience across network and endpoint security, with particular expertise in Palo Alto, Cisco ISE/NAC, EDR, WAF, and ZTNA technologies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
10 years of experience in IT Security.
Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Cisco ISE .
Experience with EDR, WAF, NAC, ZTNA, and endpoint security/hardening .
Strong understanding of enterprise network security and threat detection.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred certifications: CCNP Security, Microsoft Security certifications, or relevant GIAC certifications.
r: Manage and maintain Palo Alto firewalls , security policies, and access controls.
Manage Cisco ISE / Network Access Control (NAC) , including authentication, profiling, posture assessment, and 802.1X policies.
Implement and manage secure remote access through Prisma and Citrix ZTNA .
Configure and manage Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions and security policies.
Administer Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms for threat detection, malware prevention, and containment.
Monitor and investigate security alerts and coordinate remediation activities.
Implement endpoint hardening and security policies across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
Collaborate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Network, and Infrastructure teams on security incidents and improvements.
Support compliance with security standards including NCA, ISO 27001, and CIS .

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Store Manager oversees consistent operational excellence and holds full P&L responsibility, ensuring adherence to Brand compliance. This role fosters an environment aligned with Brand values, teamwork, result delivery, and exceptional customer service. The Store Manager is vital in planning, strategizing, and ensuring efficient store operations and financial outcomes, alongside developing staff capabilities and enhancing customer service to achieve business success.
q: Strong leadership and team management skills.
Proven ability in financial management and budgeting.
Expertise in visual merchandising and stock management.
Excellent customer service and sales capabilities.
What Qualifies You For The Role
Minimum 8 years of experience in retail and wholesale.
Experience with premium fashion brands is essential.
Ability to meet targets and handle KPIs effectively.
Strong commercial acumen and customer focus.
Proficient in critical thinking, problem solving, and communication.
Able to manage organizational, sales, and management tasks effectively.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Ensure delivery of operational standards in visual merchandising, stock availability, customer service, and safety.
